name: Hearts in Sirence
storyline:
At the end of the 21st century, a mysterious contagion known as the Chimera Complex is devastating the world. It causes painful and irreversible mutations that mimic traits of animal biology, and no patient survives for long.

You have just earned your graduate degree from a prestigious national university, and job offers are pouring in. However, when a mysterious winged figure bursts into the café where you are meeting an old friend, your life takes an unexpected turn.

Three very different men are counting on you. Will you be able to uncover a global conspiracy and heal their troubled hearts?
summary: It’s the end of the 21st century, and a mysterious new contagion is ravaging the world. Known as ‘Chimera Complex’, it causes painful and irreversible mutations that mimic aspects of animal biology in those who contract the condition. One way or another, no patient survives for long.
